subject: pri-info
title: PRI.INFO.------AF.DY.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 289 (CMOA(II)-47). PRI-INFO (principle information) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; AF-DY (affinity dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis) and CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis). From CULT-AF-BS: INFO-INTR (information interpretation). From CULT-INFO-B: STF (source transfer) and TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INFO-INTR: EXTN (existentialism), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From TM: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From EXTN: CR-INFO-DY (circular information dynamics).
